description: Source code for the DefaultPackageService implementing package installation, uninstallation, registry management, dependency handling, and environment variable checks within a package management system.

classes.name: DefaultPackageService
classes.description: Implements package management functions including install, uninstall, registry handling, and dependency management.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: Provides CLI spinner for progress indication during long operations.

methods.name: InstallPackage
methods.description: Installs a package from a source URL or local path, handling Git URLs and local package setup.

methods.name: installLocalPackage
methods.description: Handles installation of a local package, including validation, copying, dependency installation, and registry update.

methods.name: UninstallPackage
methods.description: Removes an installed package, stopping it if necessary, and updating the registry.

methods.name: uninstallPackage
methods.description: Performs the actual uninstallation process with force option.

methods.name: stopAgentNode
methods.description: Stops a running agent process by PID.

methods.name: saveRegistry
methods.description: Saves the current registry state to disk.

methods.name: ListInstalledPackages
methods.description: Returns a list of all installed packages.

methods.name: GetPackageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific installed package.

methods.name: loadRegistryDirect
methods.description: Loads registry data directly from file system.

methods.name: convertToDomainPackage
methods.description: Converts internal package data to domain model format.

methods.name: validatePackage
methods.description: Checks for required package files like agentfield-package.yaml and main.py.

methods.name: parsePackageMetadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package metadata from YAML file.

methods.name: isPackageInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a package is already installed.

methods.name: copyPackage
methods.description: Copies package files from source to destination directory.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies a single file from source to destination.

methods.name: installDependencies
methods.description: Installs Python and system dependencies, including virtual environment setup.

methods.name: updateRegistry
methods.description: Updates the registry with new package info.

methods.name: checkEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Checks for required environment variables and provides setup guidance.
